scientific_question: With 100--239 chronological samples rather than a 20-snapshot rank ceiling, what are the centered and biased MLP gradient/update spans, and which fast compact decoder tangents cover them at 0.1--1 percent retained coordinates?

existing_zero_update_asset.interpretation: exact realized optimizer updates from consecutive weights; not raw gradients

chronological_split.selection_policy: fit transform family and hyperparameters on discovery, choose on validation, evaluate test exactly once

analysis.state_and_update_spectra: exact temporal Gram eigenanalysis, both centered and uncentered
analysis.gradient_bias: T times squared mean norm divided by total sample energy, plus chronological mean cosine and relative shift
analysis.basis_transfer: discovery-only spatial PCs and mean-plus-PC affine basis projected onto validation and test

transform_controls: dense empirical PCA upper bound with kP storage reported
production fixed BlockFHT exact tangent projector

promotion_gate.basis_requirement: materially exceed both coordinate fraction and fixed BlockFHT on untouched test data, with no representative-layer collapse
promotion_gate.functional_requirement: paired c_fc/GELU/c_proj held-out action must pass before any structural LM run
promotion_gate.storage_requirement: all persistent parameters, gradients, optimizer state, seeds, and expansion buffers counted

execution.callback_action: verify live or terminal state, seal artifacts and notes, then continue only the causally authorized basis-fit plan
